senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be pointed, sharp; to sharpen.—Part. pass. שָׁנוּן, pl. שְׁנוּנִים sharpened; trnsf. ready, quick. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 108ᵃ, a. e., v. שִׁנְאָן.
to sharpen; trnsf. (cmp. חדד) to teach diligently, v. שִׁינּוּן.

units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 18:3">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII</cite> <he>והיה מְשַׁנֵּן בה כל וכ׳</he> and with this (his disposition) he cheered all Israel’s scholars.

senses.gloss: to speak distinctly. Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ bot. לא מסתברא … משנן בפיו is it not evident that in reading the Sh’mʿa every one must recite it distinctly with his own mouth?
